observed: Disconnected nodes/listeners and JS heap survive delayed triple forced GC across 60 paused and 60 further active modal cycles. Connected DOM stays stable. These are retained objects, but ownership/root cause is not yet established.

hypotheses.prediction: If native open-dialog lifecycle retains removed modal nodes, raw native showModal/remove cycles will also grow, and explicit close before removal will prevent growth.
If application/Vue effects or callbacks retain a component subtree, native-only controls will be stable but selector-free app UI cycles will still grow.
If Playwright selector/locator instrumentation retains modal nodes, equivalent keyboard or native DOM UI operation without locator resolution will release after forced GC.
If delayed DOM GC or paused scheduler alone explains retention, delayed multiple GC after real clock resume should restore counters; root followup currently contradicts this.

sourceFlow: PixelWindow calls dialog.value?.close in onUnmounted; Vue may clear template refs before that hook. WorldMap removes its resize listener in onUnmounted; setup watchers belong to component scope. Neither observation alone proves the retaining root.
scope: Only this diagnosis report directory is writable; source and production fixed build remain unchanged; no main-soak CDP/profile access.
disposition: Observed modal DOM retention is caused by the tested automation/inspector path; no game source edit is justified by this signal. Does not claim general absence of game memory leaks or QA-01 completion.

findings.H1: Not supported as an application-independent dialog-lifecycle leak: native no-selector controls return to 4 nodes / 0 listeners after GC, with either open removal or close-removal in prior probe.
findings.H2: Not supported for the measured mount/unmount DOM growth: paused same-build map and inventory without Playwright selectors return exactly to 2111 nodes / 414 listeners; native dialogs with visible waits reproduce outside Vue.
findings.H3: Supported and localized: Python 1.62.0 visible Locator.wait_for path retains nodes through inspector global handles. Installed binding discards the returned ElementHandle without disposal; detached wait and is_visible controls do not retain dialog nodes.
findings.H4: Rejected as the sole explanation: delayed GC cannot release strongly rooted inspector handles. No-selector controls are reclaimable under the same collection schedule.
findings.consoleBuffer: A new CDP session Runtime.discardConsoleEntries did not release the nodes. No console or exception events were observed. The snapshot edge label DevTools console is not a claim about user console.log or its buffer.
